Conductive Grip Hold.name: Conductive Grip Hold
Conductive Grip Hold.description: The user grips one opponent directly or through a metal object and maintains a measured shock until the end of the user's next turn. The target's muscles seize, preventing escape or an attack while the contact holds; held back, the shock ends before lasting injury. Insulation breaks the circuit, and the user cannot safely touch an ally with the same hand. Strain: moderate.
